items.title: Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_zh: 谷歌发布新前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_en: Google Announces Gemini 4 Argon, a New Frontier Model
items.summary: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier AI model, prompting extensive Hacker News debate on model leapfrogging, competitive dynamics, and the strategic importance of provider-agnostic workflows.

items.title: You said no MCP
items.title_zh: 团队发文《你说过不要 MCP》，公开反转反 MCP 立场
items.title_en: Team publicly reverses its anti-MCP stance in "You said no MCP"
items.summary: A team publicly reverses its earlier anti-MCP stance, sparking a rich HN debate about MCP versus CLI approaches and the broader AI tooling ecosystem.

items.title: 🤖 DeepSeek 开源华为昇腾基础组件
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源华为昇腾全套基础软件栈
items.title_en: DeepSeek open-sources full Ascend base software stack
items.summary: DeepSeek open-sourced a suite of base components for Huawei's Ascend platform — including TileLang compilation tools, compute and distributed communication libraries, and kernels like DeepGEMM Ascend and FlashMLA — mirroring its NVIDIA stack and supporting the Ascend 950 supernode.

items.title: Cloudflare 宣布进军公共证书颁发机构
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 宣布进军公共证书颁发机构
items.title_en: Cloudflare to Become a Public Certificate Authority
items.summary: Cloudflare announced plans to become a public certificate authority, applying to major root programs and acquiring a trusted root from GlobalSign, with ACME-first issuance and post-quantum Merkle Tree Certificates planned for 2027.

items.title: Kimi K3 接入 OpenAI Codex 企业通道，中国大模型首次进入 OpenAI 企业付费结算体系
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 经 Baseten 接入 OpenAI Codex 企业通道
items.title_en: Kimi K3 Lands in OpenAI Codex Enterprise Channel via Baseten
items.summary: Kimi K3 is now accessible via Baseten in OpenAI Codex for enterprise users, with usage billed against existing OpenAI procurement commitments, marking the first Chinese model in OpenAI's enterprise paid settlement system.

items.title: Reddit 将停用 RSS 订阅与公开 API
items.title_zh: Reddit 将以反 AI 抓取为由停用 RSS 与公开 API
items.title_en: Reddit to Kill RSS Feeds and Public API Access Over AI Scraping
items.summary: Reddit will discontinue RSS feed support on November 13 and shut down public API access by March 2027, citing AI bot scraping and automated abuse, with third-party developers required to register by January 12, 2027.
